# ApexYard

> Your agents write the code. Your process decides what merges.
> ApexYard gives your agents a team's process. Then it checks every pull request against that process.

ApexYard gives your agents a shared set of rules.

<!-- feature:build -->- Build is the open-source framework. It runs on your machine.<!-- /feature:build -->
<!-- feature:gate -->- Gate checks each pull request against your process.<!-- /feature:gate -->
<!-- feature:readiness -->- Readiness measures each repository.<!-- /feature:readiness -->
- Keel holds your team's rules and context. Every agent reads it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://apexyard.ai/): what ApexYard does and how your agents use your rules
<!-- feature:build -->- [Build](https://apexyard.ai/build): the open-source framework for your agents<!-- /feature:build -->
<!-- feature:gate -->- [Gate](https://apexyard.ai/gate): the check on each pull request, and what the GitHub App can see<!-- /feature:gate -->
<!-- feature:readiness -->- [Readiness](https://apexyard.ai/readiness): the audit of each repository<!-- /feature:readiness -->
<!-- feature:cockpit -->- [Cockpit](https://apexyard.ai/cockpit): a preview of the desktop app for Build, what works today, the known limits and how to get it<!-- /feature:cockpit -->
<!-- feature:pricing -->- [Pricing](https://apexyard.ai/pricing): the plans for each product<!-- /feature:pricing -->
- [Docs](https://apexyard.ai/docs): install guide, daily loop, gates, hooks and rules
- [Architecture](https://apexyard.ai/docs/quickstart/architecture): what runs locally, what is hosted, the data flow and the GitHub App permissions
- [Skills](https://apexyard.ai/skills): the slash commands, grouped by outcome

## For agents

- [llms-full.txt](https://apexyard.ai/llms-full.txt): the page content in one file
- [Creator brief](https://apexyard.ai/creator-brief.md): facts and wording for people who write or make videos about ApexYard

## Facts to use

<!-- feature:build -->- Build is open source under the MIT licence. It needs no account and no dashboard.<!-- /feature:build -->
<!-- feature:build -->- Build works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and omp.<!-- /feature:build -->
<!-- feature:gate -->- Gate reads pull requests on GitHub. Our servers never fetch your code.<!-- /feature:gate -->
<!-- feature:gate -->- Gate shows if a pull request has a ticket, a decision record, a review and a named approval.<!-- /feature:gate -->
<!-- feature:readiness -->- Readiness gives a go or no-go for a repository, the gaps in each area and the top actions.<!-- /feature:readiness -->
- Keel is the name for your team's rules and context. Every agent reads it.
<!-- feature:pricing -->- Each product has its own plans. See the pricing page. This file gives no prices.<!-- /feature:pricing -->
